description: Former New Hampshire Supreme Court Chief Justice Bob Lynn released an opinion defending the constitutionality of HB 544, the bill barring state employees and contractors from teaching or training certain “divisive concepts.” NH Journal reports that in a memo to House Majority Leader Jason Osborne, Lynn argued government may direct the speech of its employees ...
